name: DONeRF
definition: A compact dual network design for real-time neural rendering that replaces NeRF's MLP-based raymarching with a local sampling strategy. It uses a depth oracle network to predict sample locations and a shading network to accumulate RGBA output using only a few samples per ray.
summary: DONeRF is a real-time NeRF variant using a depth oracle and shading network to render images with only two to four samples per pixel, decoupling geometry and appearance training.
